coverage_note: The current database contains Scolytinae records only. Platypodinae is part of the long-term project scope but has not yet been integrated into the database.
geographic_scope: China checklist, including separately tracked Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao occurrence assessments where available.
profile_count_status: 574 source-supported China Scolytinae taxon profiles through VSN_6555. VSN_2721 (Euwallacea praevius (Blandford, 1894)) is excluded from the Chinese checklist: Li et al. (2020: 149) documented some praevius-labelled Chinese museum specimens were Xyleborus festivus, while CO2015_162 lacks independent verified-voucher confirmation. This partial misidentification is not nomenclatural synonymy and does not transfer all historical occurrences or hosts to VSN_6220. VSN_6154 and VSN_6345 remain excluded, as does VSN_4713. Global taxonomic entities and original sources remain in Notion. VSN_1355 (Coptoborus vespatorius) is excluded: Huang & Lu (2015) entry CO2015_172 published Coptoborus emarginatus Eichhoff, illustrated as Debus emarginatus; that source was mislinked to VSN_1355 and has been reassigned in Notion to VSN_2207. No independent evidence from that source supports vespatorius in China. Globally accepted nomenclatural backbone retained; website profile removed. VSN_4812 (Procryphalus mucronatus) excluded 13 October 2026: 1984/2015 fraxini evidence was wrongly crosswalked to VSN_4812 and has been corrected to VSN_4811; no independent Chinese occurrence verified. Global SRL identity retained. VSN_1618 was added from Lin & Beaver (2023), with Taiwan type-locality and host evidence; the previously frozen 573-row scientific audit scope remains unchanged.
